errors.text: The proposed second phase is a Laves intermetallic, directly conflicting with the requirement for a dual-phase solid-solution structure without brittle intermetallic formation.
The material system and processing route do not reconstruct the CoCrFeNiTi powder-metallurgy system, high-energy ball milling, or spark-plasma sintering.
None of the cited evidence demonstrates cryogenic HPT or ECAP followed by sub-solvus annealing producing a sub-50 nm BCC plus nano-Laves microstructure.
Claims of coherent BCC/Laves interfaces, Orowan strengthening, suppressed crack propagation, and retained tensile ductility above 10% are unsupported by the cited evidence.

The stated stability boundary is thermodynamically confused: heating above the Laves solvus should dissolve the Laves phase rather than directly cause its coarsening; coarsening generally occurs during exposure within the two-phase field.

The proposed experiment does not cleanly distinguish grain-boundary and precipitation strengthening from solid-solution strengthening because it lacks composition-matched, grain-size-matched, and precipitate-free annealing controls.
